in_sanskrit.name: Monika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain, hill, or jewel
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Monika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'monu' which means 'mountain' or 'hill'. In Hindu mythology, mountains are considered sacred as they are believed to be the dwelling places of various gods and goddesses. The name Monika can also be derived from the Sanskrit word 'manikya', which means 'jewel'. This name symbolizes the beauty and strength of nature and the importance of valuing the precious things in life.
